summary: Comprehensive technical roadmap, system architecture, database schema, and product design for the Unified Wealth Management & Reinvestment Engine. Covers multi-currency portfolio tracking (Mutual Funds, Demat, FD/RD, SGB, Bonds, PF, NPS, Savings), automated maturity reinvestment recommendations across 4 risk tiers (5-8 curated solutions), tax harvesting and diversification engine, and interactive macroeconomic stress simulation with dynamic portfolio shuffling.
